name: search_files
description: Search files by keywords, directory, extension, modification time, size, and file metadata.

query.description: Keywords or phrases to search for in file names or contents.

extension.description: File extension, such as py, md, yaml, or json, without the leading dot.

modified_after.description: Lower bound for modification time, in ISO-8601 format.

modified_before.description: Upper bound for modification time, in ISO-8601 format.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return.

include_hidden.description: Whether hidden files should be included.
